case.title: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH. Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor. Need: 30000 kits a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 5 days). Fallback if you walk away: today's terms continue unchanged. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70610.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

It is always a pleasure to work with you, and we are delighted to present our proposal for your component requirements. As a reliable supply partner, we pride ourselves on delivering excellent service and maintaining a comprehensive product range to keep your production running smoothly. 

For the requested volume, we can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit. This quote comes with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this proposal meets your expectations and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
move.body:
Dear Franz Stadler,

Thank you for your quotation and your continued interest in our business. Your broad product range supports consolidating the kit with you, provided delivery performance improves.

Our demand forecast for this part has changed +15.3% (fc:360011@2026-09). Your on-time delivery over the last four quarters was 88.6% (sc:70610@2026Q3).

Our analysis supports the proposed pricing through consolidation, growing demand and a longer commitment that helps you plan capacity and seek internal approval. We are flexible on payment terms; the option retaining your quoted terms is included, so please choose the package that works best for you.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.20 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option B: EUR 5.14 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option C: EUR 5.15 per unit, payment 45 days net, 24-month agreement.

We look forward to building on our relationship with a dependable kit supply arrangement.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. However, we appreciate your detailed feedback and the prospect of a 24-month agreement, which provides valuable planning security for both sides. Taking into account the verified volume increase, we can revise our offer to a price of €5.51 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

Regarding the delivery performance, please be assured that we are continuously optimizing our logistics processes to meet your expectations. At the same time, a binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? 

Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.body:
Dear Franz Stadler,

Thank you for revising your price; we accept that verified delivery results do not by themselves change your calculation. Your point about binding volume and planning security is fair, and our proposal is based on the kit volume in your schedule.

We have made a modest price step and expect a further concession for the bundled business and longer commitment, with award conditional on credible delivery improvement. We are flexible on payment; the option retaining your requested net payment term is included, so please choose what works best for approval. We can commit to over 24 months, as set out in the term sheets.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.30 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option B: EUR 5.23 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option C: EUR 5.25 per unit, payment 45 days net, 24-month agreement.

We look forward to putting this kit together commercially as well as mechanically.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
